```{r}
course_filter_data <- merge(course_filter_data, valence_value_avg, by = "story", all.x = TRUE)

sentiment_files <- list.files(
  path = "/Users/UChicago/CASNL/storyfest/storyfest/data/pupil/3_processed/16_course_sentiment_by_event_transformer/my_transformer", 
  pattern = "_sentiment_transformer_copy.csv$", 
  full.names = TRUE
)

valence_list <- lapply(sentiment_files, function(file) {
  df <- read.csv(file)
  df$story <- gsub("_sentiment_transformer_copy.csv", "", basename(file))  # extract story name
  return(df)
})

valence_df <- do.call(rbind, valence_list)

valence_df <- valence_df %>%
  rename(event_num = event_number)

valence_df <- valence_df %>%
  rename(valence_event_label = predicted_label)

course_filter_data <- merge(course_filter_data, valence_df[, c("story", "event_num", "valence_event_label", "valence_event_continuous", "arousal_event_score")],
               by = c("story", "event_num"),
               all.x = TRUE)

course_filter_data$story<-as.factor(course_filter_data$story)
course_filter_data$valence<-as.factor(course_filter_data$valence)
course_filter_data$subject<-as.factor(course_filter_data$subject)
course_filter_data$valence <- relevel(course_filter_data$valence, ref="neutral")
course_filter_data$valence_event_label<-as.factor(course_filter_data$valence_event_label)
course_filter_data$valence_event_label <- relevel(course_filter_data$valence_event_label, ref="neutral")

# pos, neu, neg data

  filter(story %in% c("Pool Party", "Impatient Billionaire"))

course_filter_pos_data$valence_event_label<-as.factor(course_filter_pos_data$valence_event_label)
course_filter_pos_data$valence_event_label <- relevel(course_filter_pos_data$valence_event_label, ref="neutral")

course_filter_neu_data <- course_filter_data %>%
```

```{r}
story_order <- c("Dont Look", "Natalie Wood", "Sea Ice",
                 "Grandfather Clocks", "Impatient Billionaire", "Pool Party")

# If you’re starting from per-event rows:
valence_by_story <- course_filter_data %>%
  group_by(story, valence_label) %>%
  summarise(
    n_events     = sum(!is.na(valence_event_continuous)),
    mean_valence = mean(valence_event_continuous, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_valence   = sd(valence_event_continuous,   na.rm = TRUE),
    se_valence   = sd_valence / sqrt(n_events),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    story = factor(story, levels = story_order),
    valence_label = factor(valence_label, levels = c("negative", "neutral", "positive"))
  )

p <- ggplot(valence_by_story, aes(x = story, y = mean_valence, fill = valence_label)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_valence - se_valence, ymax = mean_valence + se_valence),
                width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = story_order) +  # hard-enforce left→right order
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("negative"="blue","neutral"="gray","positive"="red"),
    limits = c("negative","neutral","positive")  # bar/legend order within each story
  ) +
  labs(title="Valence (Mean Across Events) per Story",
       x="Story", y="Mean Valence (± SE)", fill="Valence") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, NA))
p
```

```{r}
# 1) Normal-approx posterior draws for beta_zpupil
b_hat <- fixef(mdl3_course_filter)["z_pupil"]
se_b  <- sqrt(vcov(mdl3_course_filter)["z_pupil","z_pupil"])
set.seed(123)
beta_draws <- rnorm(8000, mean = b_hat, sd = se_b)

# 2) Boxed posterior plot (single distribution)
plot_posterior_boxed <- function(draws, title_text = NULL, hist_fill = "#9bd3e6") {
  m   <- mean(draws)
  ci  <- quantile(draws, c(0.025, 0.975))
  pgt <- mean(draws > 0)

  dens <- density(draws); ymax <- max(dens$y)
  df <- tibble(mu = draws)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = mu)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                   bins = 40, fill = hist_fill, alpha = 0.85, color = NA) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = ci[1], xend = ci[2], y = 0, yend = 0),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 3.0, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = ci[1], y = 0, label = sprintf("%.3f", ci[1]),
             vjust = -1.1, size = 4) +
    annotate("text", x = ci[2], y = 0, label = sprintf("%.3f", ci[2]),
             vjust = -1.1, size = 4) +
    annotate("text", x = m, y = 0.85 * ymax, label = sprintf("Mean=%.3f", m),
             size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = m, y = 0.72 * ymax, label = sprintf("P(posterior > 0)=%.3f", pgt),
             size = 4.5) +
    labs(x = "Posterior distribution (β for z_pupil)", y = NULL, title = title_text) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, ymax * 1.05)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )
}

p <- plot_posterior_boxed(beta_draws, title_text = "Pupil predicts memory (β for z_pupil)")
print(p)
```

```{r}
# ---- helper: posterior draws for a fixed-effect term from an lmer model ----
get_beta_draws_from_lmer <- function(mod, term = "z_pupil", n_draws = 8000) {
  # try full MVN sim of fixed effects if 'arm' is available; fallback to normal approx for the term
  if (requireNamespace("arm", quietly = TRUE)) {
    s <- arm::sim(mod, n.sims = n_draws)
    beta_mat <- as.matrix(coef(s))  # sims x terms
    if (!term %in% colnames(beta_mat)) stop(sprintf("Term '%s' not found in model.", term))
    as.numeric(beta_mat[, term])
  } else {
    b  <- fixef(mod)
    V  <- vcov(mod)
    if (!term %in% names(b)) stop(sprintf("Term '%s' not found in model.", term))
    mean <- b[term]
    sd   <- sqrt(V[term, term])
    rnorm(n_draws, mean = mean, sd = sd)
  }
}

# ---- boxed posterior plot (histogram + dashed 0, baseline 95% CI, annotations) ----
plot_posterior_boxed <- function(draws, title_text = NULL, hist_fill = "#CFCFCF",
                                 prob_side = c(">", "<")[1]) {
  m   <- mean(draws)
  ci  <- quantile(draws, c(0.025, 0.975))
  p   <- if (prob_side == ">") mean(draws > 0) else mean(draws < 0)
  prob_lab <- if (prob_side == ">") sprintf("P(posterior > 0)=%.3f", p)
                                else sprintf("P(posterior < 0)=%.3f", p)

  dens <- density(draws); ymax <- max(dens$y)
  df <- tibble(mu = draws)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = mu)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                   bins = 40, fill = hist_fill, alpha = 0.85, color = NA) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = ci[1], xend = ci[2], y = 0, yend = 0),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 3.0, color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = ci[1], y = 0, label = sprintf("%.3f", ci[1]),
             vjust = -1.1, size = 4) +
    annotate("text", x = ci[2], y = 0, label = sprintf("%.3f", ci[2]),
             vjust = -1.1, size = 4) +
    annotate("text", x = m, y = 0.85 * ymax, label = sprintf("Mean=%.3f", m),
             size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = m, y = 0.72 * ymax, label = prob_lab,
             size = 4.5) +
    labs(x = "Posterior distribution (β for z_pupil)", y = NULL, title = title_text) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, ymax * 1.05)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )
}

# ---- soft colors (your picks) ----
valence_cols <- c(
  positive = "#EFA3A3",   # soft red
  negative = "#9BC7E3",   # soft blue
  neutral  = "#CFCFCF"    # soft gray
)

# ---- build the three posteriors (term = "z_pupil") ----
draws_pos <- get_beta_draws_from_lmer(mdl3_course_filter_pos, term = "z_pupil")
draws_neg <- get_beta_draws_from_lmer(mdl3_course_filter_neg, term = "z_pupil")
draws_neu <- get_beta_draws_from_lmer(mdl3_course_filter_neu, term = "z_pupil")

p_pos <- plot_posterior_boxed(draws_pos, "Valence: Positive",
                              hist_fill = valence_cols["positive"], prob_side = ">")
p_neg <- plot_posterior_boxed(draws_neg, "Valence: Negative",
                              hist_fill = valence_cols["negative"], prob_side = "<")  # show P(<0)
p_neu <- plot_posterior_boxed(draws_neu, "Valence: Neutral",
                              hist_fill = valence_cols["neutral"],  prob_side = ">")

# view
print(p_pos); print(p_neg); print(p_neu)
```

```{r}
# install.packages("brms")

library(cmdstanr)
cmdstanr::install_cmdstan()
options(brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
```

```{r}
# Set priors
prior <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
  prior(exponential(1), class = sd),
  prior(exponential(1), class = sigma)
)

# Fit linear model
fit_recall_pupil <- brm(
 # recall_accuracy_z ~ pupil_size_z + (1 | subj),
  cosine_similarity ~ z_pupil + (1 | subject),
  data = course_filter_data,
  prior = prior,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  chains = 4, cores = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 1000, seed = 123,
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE))

# Posterior distribution of model
post_recall_pupil <- as_draws_df(fit_recall_pupil)$b_z_pupil
b_recall_pupil = median(post_recall_pupil)

# Summary of posterior
# posterior_interval(post_recall_pupil, prob = 0.95)
hdi_recall_pupil <- hdi(post_recall_pupil, ci=0.95, method="HDI")

# Prop. posterior > 0
gt_0_recall_pupil_pos <- sum(post_recall_pupil > 0)/length(post_recall_pupil)
```

```{r}
# === ** Report ** === #
cat("b:", round(median(b_recall_pupil),2), "\n")
cat("95% HDI:", paste0("[", round(hdi_recall_pupil$CI_low, 2), ", ",
                       round(hdi_recall_pupil$CI_high, 2), "]"), "\n")
cat("p(b>0):", round(gt_0_recall_pupil_pos, 3), "\n")



# === ** Figure ** === #
hist_recall_pupil <- ggplot(data.frame(post_recall_pupil), aes(x=post_recall_pupil)) + 
  geom_histogram(fill="lightblue") +
  labs(x="Posterior distribution") +
  geom_vline(xintercept=0, colour="azure4", linetype=2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = "black") +
  theme_classic()   +
  theme(
    legend.position="none",
    text=element_text(size=22, family="Arial", color="black"),
    axis.title=element_text(size=22, color="black"),
    axis.text.x=element_text(size=22, color="black"),
    axis.text.y=element_blank(),
    axis.title.y=element_blank(),    
    panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent'),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill='transparent', color=NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill='transparent'),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill='transparent'),
    plot.margin=margin(0, 1, 0, 1, "cm")
  ) +
  # Add HDI
  geom_errorbarh(aes(y=0, x=hdi_recall_pupil$CI_low, xmin=hdi_recall_pupil$CI_low, xmax=hdi_recall_pupil$CI_high), col="black", size=2) +
  geom_text(aes(x=hdi_recall_pupil$CI_low, y=1, label=round(hdi_recall_pupil$CI_low,3)), vjust=-0.5, color="black", size=7) +
  geom_text(aes(x=hdi_recall_pupil$CI_high, y=1, label=round(hdi_recall_pupil$CI_high,3)), vjust=-0.5, color="black", size=7) +
  geom_text(aes(x=median(post_recall_pupil), y=5, label=paste0("Median=", round(median(post_recall_pupil),3))), vjust=-8.5, color="black", size=7) +
  # Add prop. posterior
  geom_text(aes(x=median(post_recall_pupil), y=1, label=paste0("P(posterior > 0)=", round(gt_0_recall_pupil_pos, 3))), 
            vjust=-7.0, color="black", size=7, fontface="italic") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.1))
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Make sure 'valence' is a 2-level factor
course_filter_emotional <- course_filter_emotional %>%
  mutate(valence = factor(valence, levels = c("negative","positive")))

res99 <- lmer(cosine_similarity ~ z_pupil * valence + (1|subject) + (1|story),
              data = course_filter_emotional)

# ----- Simple slopes forest (unchanged; no new-levels issue) -----
slopes <- emtrends(res99, ~ valence, var = "z_pupil")
slopes_df <- as.data.frame(slopes) %>%
  rename(slope = z_pupil.trend, lower = lower.CL, upper = upper.CL)

p_forest <- ggplot(slopes_df, aes(x = slope, y = valence)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), size = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Slope of z_pupil on cosine_similarity", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

# # ----- Marginal effects lines WITHOUT random effects -----
newdat <- expand.grid(
  z_pupil = seq(-2, 2, length.out = 50),
  valence = levels(course_filter_emotional$valence)
)

pred_fix <- predict(res99, newdata = newdat, re.form = NA, se.fit = TRUE)  # fixed-effects only

newdat$fit   <- pred_fix$fit
newdat$lower <- pred_fix$fit - 1.96 * pred_fix$se.fit
newdat$upper <- pred_fix$fit + 1.96 * pred_fix$se.fit

p_lines <- ggplot(newdat, aes(x = z_pupil, y = fit, color = valence, fill = valence)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(x = "z_pupil", y = "Predicted cosine_similarity") +
  theme_minimal()

p_forest
p_lines

```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# --- 0) Factor hygiene (good to keep) ---
course_filter_emotional <- course_filter_emotional %>%
  mutate(
    valence = factor(valence, levels = c("negative","positive")),
    subject = factor(subject),
    story   = factor(story)
  )

# --- 1) Fit model ---
res99 <- lmer(
  cosine_similarity ~ z_pupil * valence + total_num_events +
    (1 | subject) + (1 | story),
  data = course_filter_emotional,
  REML = TRUE
)

# --- 2) Per-story totals (if constant per story, mean() is fine) ---
events_by_story <- course_filter_emotional %>%
  group_by(story) %>%
  summarise(total_num_events = mean(total_num_events, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# --- 3) Simple slopes forest (unchanged) ---
slopes <- emtrends(res99, ~ valence, var = "z_pupil")
slopes_df <- as.data.frame(confint(slopes)) %>%
  rename(slope = z_pupil.trend, lower = lower.CL, upper = upper.CL)

p_forest <- ggplot(slopes_df, aes(x = slope, y = valence)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), size = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Slope of z_pupil on cosine_similarity", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()

# --- 4) Build FULL prediction grid: z_pupil × story × valence ---
z_grid <- seq(-2, 2, length.out = 101)

pred_data <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  z_pupil = z_grid,
  story   = levels(course_filter_emotional$story),
  valence = levels(course_filter_emotional$valence)
) %>%
  left_join(events_by_story, by = "story") %>%
  # subject is random; include a dummy level so factors are known (random effects are not added)
  mutate(subject = levels(course_filter_emotional$subject)[1])

# --- 5) Build reference grid FROM our pred_data, then average over story ---
rg <- ref_grid(res99, data = pred_data)
em_grid <- emmeans(rg, ~ valence | z_pupil)  # averages over story because story varies in pred_data

pred_df <- as.data.frame(confint(em_grid)) %>%
  rename(fit = emmean, lower = lower.CL, upper = upper.CL)

# --- 6) Plot: fixed-effects lines that respect per-story total_num_events ---
p_lines <- ggplot(pred_df, aes(x = z_pupil, y = fit, color = valence, fill = valence)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(x = "z_pupil", y = "Predicted cosine_similarity") +
  theme_minimal()

p_forest
p_lines

```

```{r}
library(emmeans)
emtrends(res99, ~ valence, var = "z_pupil")      # slopes + CIs per valence
pairs(emtrends(res99, ~ valence, var = "z_pupil")) # test of slope difference (interaction)
```
